item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson made a surprise appearance Feb. 10 at the Chicago LGBTQ+ Advisory Council’s quarterly meeting to thank outgoing chair Jin-Soo Huh for years of volunteer leadership. “The fact that you’ve already been applauded—then there’s no need for me to say anything other than [that] your work speaks for itself,” Johnson told Huh.
